title: 怎麼
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L144 怎. Use these sentences exactly; spokenText equals text with punctuation removed. L144 depends on L142 為 and L143 以; do not merge production JSON until L142-L143 are present in latest origin/main. Provisional learned chars are 為 and 以. Use 為, not 爲. Use 裡, not 裏. Do not add unlearned characters such as 所, 能, 嗎, 錯, 進. Images must use L058 style anchors and contain no text, numbers, zhuyin, labels, signs, letters, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio for 怎, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.
